security_audit.summary: All 94 static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline-code backticks around hex color values. content.user_title: Choose PPT Color and Font Themes
content.value_statement: Presentation themes can look inconsistent when colors and fonts are chosen ad hoc. This skill gives ready palettes, design tokens, and font guidance for polished PPT work.
actual_capabilities: Recommends 18 presentation palette options with use cases and styling notes.
Provides detailed white, gold, blue, gray, and opacity color token scales.
Suggests Chinese and English system fonts for cross-platform PPT compatibility.
Guides palette selection for business, healthcare, education, luxury, and technology decks.
Supports mixed Chinese and English typography choices for presentation layouts.
limitations: It does not generate slide files or edit PPT documents directly.
It does not verify brand accessibility or color contrast automatically.
It provides static guidance, not live design-system synchronization.
It focuses on PPT and visual themes, not full copywriting or data analysis.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Executive Deck
use_cases.description: Select a professional palette and font pairing for a board report or investor presentation.

use_cases.title: Build a Brand Theme
use_cases.description: Choose consistent color tokens and typography for a product, website, or marketing deck.

use_cases.title: Localize Bilingual Slides
use_cases.description: Apply readable Chinese and English font choices for mixed-language presentation content.

prompt_templates.title: Pick a Simple Palette
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner selection for a new presentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose a color palette for a PPT about [topic]. Explain the main colors, accent color, and best font choice.

prompt_templates.title: Match a Presentation Mood
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate guidance based on audience and tone.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a PPT theme for [audience] with a [tone] style. Include colors, font pairing, and slide usage notes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Brand-Safe Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced theme planning for branded work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a brand-safe PPT theme for [brand or product]. Use the skill palette guidance and explain title, background, chart, and callout colors.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Refine a Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing design direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this presentation style: [describe colors, fonts, audience, and purpose]. Improve the palette, typography, and hierarchy using this skill.

output_examples.input: A healthcare startup needs a calm investor deck.
output_examples.output: Use the modern health palette. Use deep teal for titles, pale blue for backgrounds, and warm coral for restrained highlights.

output_examples.input: A bilingual product launch deck needs premium styling.
output_examples.output: Use the platinum white-gold theme. Pair Microsoft YaHei for Chinese text with Arial for English body text.

output_examples.input: An education report needs readable charts.
output_examples.output: Use the education and chart palette. Keep dark blue for headings, teal for key data, and orange for comparison points.

best_practices: State the audience, topic, and tone before asking for palette advice.
Use one primary color, one accent color, and neutral backgrounds for most slides.
Keep system fonts when the presentation must open reliably across devices.
anti_patterns: Do not mix several palette families in one deck without a clear hierarchy.
Do not use pale text on pale backgrounds without checking readability.
Do not choose decorative fonts when the deck must be edited by many people.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps choose PPT color palettes, design tokens, and font pairings for presentation design.

faq.question: Can it create a PowerPoint file?
faq.answer: No. It provides design guidance that you can apply in PowerPoint or another slide tool.

faq.question: Does it support Chinese and English slides?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends Microsoft YaHei for Chinese and common system fonts for English.

faq.question: Can I use it for brand design?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes palette families and token scales that can support brand theme planning.

faq.question: Does it check accessibility?
faq.answer: No. You should still test contrast, readability, and viewer needs before publishing slides.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
